subject: POC trial environment options and next steps

Subject: POC trial environment options and next steps

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we start the trial: 

Success criteria (as discussed)
- Inference latency at 95th percentile under target load: < 200ms
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent requests with tail latency SLA
- Cost/run: baseline metrics captured for 1-week peak and steady-state
- Feature validation: streaming + function calling and prefix caching work for your payloads

POC evaluation plan
- Environment options (pick one):
  1) Hosted sandbox (Redwood hosted API) — fastest to get started, simple network (no inbound firewall changes), good for functional validation and baseline cost/latency.
  2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool) — isolated capacity, predictable throughput; useful if you need consistent perf under concurrency.
  3) VPC trial (customer VPC / Private deployment) — full network isolation and KMS integration; required if you must keep traffic on your VPC.

Pros/cons summary attached (see poc-checklist.xlsx and network-requirements.pdf). My recommendation for your goals (latency + security controls) is to start with a 2-week hosted sandbox to validate features and basic perf, then move to a short dedicated sandbox run if we need consistent throughput, and parallel-track an evaluation of VPC onboarding if procurement/security want full isolation.

Proposed timeline
- Confirm environment choice by Mon 16 Nov
- Kickoff & environment prepared by Mon 23 Nov
- 2-week evaluation window Nov 23–Dec 7
- Final review w/ metrics week of Dec 7

Ownership / next steps
- Marissa (me): coordinate timeline, secure paperwork, monitor success criteria
- Dylan (engineering): environment setup and runbook (I’ve CC’d him)
- Markus (security): SOC2/Q checklist and network review
- Ben / Acme AI: confirm environment choice, provide network contact and tentative kickoff date

Action items for you: please confirm which environment you want to start with (hosted / dedicated / VPC) and add your network contact so Dylan can schedule the setup.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Marissa Cole
